name: Restoration of America PAC
summary: A conservative super PAC founded by Doug Truax and funded overwhelmingly by Richard Uihlein: more than $80 million from him in the 2024 cycle, when it spent over $34 million against Kamala Harris, and more than $57 million from January 2025 to June 2026. In the 2026 cycle most of its money went on to other conservative groups.

sources.title: Billionaires poured millions of dollars into presidential super PACs in August — NBC News

finances.description: Uihlein gave it more than $57M from January 2025 to June 2026; most of its spending went to other conservative groups.

connections.name: Richard Uihlein
connections.description: Its main funder: more than $80 million in the 2024 cycle and more than $57 million from January 2025 to June 2026. FEC filings show $273,979,404 from Richard Uihlein to Restoration of America PAC in 6 cycles (2016–2026).
